title: Project snapshot
statement: The system shall keep one snapshot per project in state/HOT.md with Now, Next and Watch sections and a Last reconciled date, at most 8,192 bytes, changed only by applying a proposed changeset.
rationale: A small, always-current summary lets every session start from the project's real state instead of chat history.

acceptance_criteria.text: state/HOT.md has the headings Now, Next and Watch in that order and a line 'Last reconciled: YYYY-MM-DD'; Next holds exactly 1 item
A changeset may carry a snapshot op with the full new content; the changeset card shows its diff, Apply writes and commits it, and 0 other paths write the file
Simulate reports an error for a snapshot over 8,192 bytes, without the 3 required headings, or with more than 1 Next item
Lint warns when Last reconciled is more than 21 days old

source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe
